description: This Java class 'MetadataModelFactory' provides static factory methods for creating and initializing 'Metadata' objects, including empty, null, and JSON-initialized instances, as well as builders for 'Metadata'. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.metadata' package and uses regex pattern matching for JSON key validation.

classes.name: MetadataModelFactory
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to create and initialize 'Metadata' objects, including empty, null, and JSON-based instances, as well as builders.

methods.name: emptyMetadata
methods.description: Returns a new immutable empty 'Metadata' object.

methods.name: nullMetadata
methods.description: Returns a new immutable 'Metadata' object that represents null.

methods.name: newMetadata (JsonObject jsonObject)
methods.description: Creates a new 'Metadata' initialized with values from the provided JsonObject, validating keys with a regex pattern.

methods.name: newMetadata (String jsonString)
methods.description: Creates a new 'Metadata' from a JSON string, parsing it into a JsonObject first.

methods.name: newMetadataBuilder (Metadata metadata)
methods.description: Returns a builder initialized with an existing 'Metadata' instance.
